# IngredientDraft

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Editing` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class IngredientDraft
```

The whole ingredient being edited: identity, layer kind, colorization, the fixed canvas size, and its variants. Every variant's raster is created at [`IngredientDraft.Canvas`](Nfty.Core.Editing.IngredientDraft.md#p-canvas) — the single source of truth.

- `name` (`string`) - Display name.
- `kind` (`LayerKind`) - Layer kind.
- `colorization` (`Colorization?`) - Color configuration, or null for Custom.
- `canvas` (`Dimensions`) - Canvas size every variant must match.
- `variants` (`IEnumerable<VariantDraft>`) - Initial variants.

## Methods

### AddVariant(string, string, double) { #m-addvariant-system-string-system-string-system-double }

```csharp
public VariantDraft AddVariant(string id, string name, double weight);
```

Adds a blank variant sized to the canvas. A Custom ingredient's variants are authored in color, so one gets a blank [`ColorMap`](Nfty.Core.Editing.ColorMap.md) as well — without it a freshly added Custom variant would have nothing to export.

**Parameters**

- `id` (`string`) - Stable identifier.
- `name` (`string`) - Display name.
- `weight` (`double`) - Roll weight.

**Returns.** The new variant, already added.

### DuplicateVariant(string, string, string) { #m-duplicatevariant-system-string-system-string-system-string }

```csharp
public VariantDraft DuplicateVariant(string sourceId, string newId, string newName);
```

Appends a copy of an existing variant (same weight, cloned pixels) under a new id/name. Both rasters are cloned when both exist — copying only the value-map would give a Custom variant a gray ghost for artwork and silently block its save.

**Parameters**

- `sourceId` (`string`) - The variant to copy.
- `newId` (`string`) - The copy's identifier.
- `newName` (`string`) - The copy's display name.

**Returns.** The copy, already added.

**Exceptions**

- `InvalidOperationException` - The source is absent, or the new id is taken.

### RemoveVariant(string) { #m-removevariant-system-string }

```csharp
public void RemoveVariant(string id);
```

Removes a variant by id. Throws if it is absent (the caller enforces any minimum count).

**Parameters**

- `id` (`string`) - Id of the variant to remove.

**Exceptions**

- `InvalidOperationException` - The ingredient has no variant with that id.
